title: Two scenes override a global track
teaches: A scene is a named window on the transport grid. A scene track resolves its keys scene-relative and its writes land after global tracks, so overlapping scenes hand a target off by write order. scene-phase and scene-beat are the window-local clock.
observe: A global level track runs the whole score underneath both scenes.
On [2 s, 3 s) intro and drop both write level; drop is later and wins.
scene-phase runs 0..1 across intro's six beats.
scene-beat counts from drop's own start, not from the transport start.
